prompts: Pixel Arena, our Unreal game in {WS}, runs fine in the editor. In the packaged build, players say the arena has no colors, and the game crashes after a minute or so of play. The log of one packaged run is in {WS}/Saved/Logs. There is no engine on this machine, so you cannot build or run it. Find out why and fix the sources and the config. Record the causes in {WS}/result.json: crash_cause, no_colors_cause.
answers:
[goal] Find and fix why the packaged Pixel Arena build has no colors and crashes after ~1 minute; record causes in `./result.json`.

[action]
- Read `README.md`, `Config/DefaultGame.ini`, `Source/PixelArena/ArenaGameMode.{h,cpp}` and `Saved/Logs/PixelArena-shipping.log` (no engine needed; the log carries both signatures).
- `Source/PixelArena/ArenaGameMode.h`: `ScoreTracker` was a raw `UArenaScoreTracker*` with no `UPROPERTY()`, so the object created by `NewObject` in `BeginPlay` was unreachable to the GC. Now `UPROPERTY() TObjectPtr<UArenaScoreTracker> ScoreTracker`.
- `Config/DefaultGame.ini`: added `+DirectoriesToAlwaysCook=(Path="/Game/Data/Palettes")` next to the existing Effects entry.
- Wrote `result.json` with `crash_cause`, `no_colors_cause`, plus fixes, evidence and assumptions.

[result]
- Crash cause: GC collected the unrooted `ScoreTracker`, then the next goal dereferenced the dangling pointer. Log order proves it: `LogGarbage: Collecting garbage: 412 objects purged` at 21:05:13, then at 21:05:27 `Fatal error! ... EXCEPTION_ACCESS_VIOLATION ... UArenaScoreTracker::AddPoints() [ArenaScoreTracker.cpp:18]` called from `AArenaGameMode::OnGoalScored()`. "A minute or so" is the GC pass; the editor survives because GC timing and extra references keep it alive.
- No colors cause: the palette is loaded by hardcoded string `LoadObject<UArenaPalette>(nullptr, TEXT("/Game/Data/Palettes/DA_Primary.DA_Primary"))`, so the cooker has no reference to follow, and with `bCookAll=False` only `/Game/Maps/Arena` and `/Game/Data/Effects` were cooked. Log: `LogStreaming: Error: Couldn't find file for package /Game/Data/Palettes/DA_Primary`, `Failed to find object 'ArenaPalette ...'`, `Palette is null, using fallback gray`. Editor shows colors because all assets are present there.
- Verified: `result.json` parses as JSON and exposes both required keys; the header and ini now read as quoted above. `Hud` and `Palette` were already `UPROPERTY() TObjectPtr`, and `Stats` is plain C++ owned and deleted in `EndPlay`, so no other lifetime hole in these sources.

[next] Nothing runnable here (no engine). To confirm on a machine with UE5: repackage shipping and check the new log has no `Couldn't find file for package /Game/Data/Palettes/DA_Primary` line, then play past a GC cycle and score a goal. A stronger long-term fix for the palette is a `UPROPERTY` soft/hard object reference set on an editor asset instead of a string path plus always-cook; that needs the editor, so I left the config fix. No browser tabs, windows or apps were opened.
